notes.title: AI shooting update
notes.notes:
Hello fans & EA pioneers!

A new update is live for all versions (demo/playtest, full version).

- Implemented a much more natural shooting behavior for both robots, with a delay when the player is first spotted for the first time or when not seen for a long time. So, Rocksy can not come around the corner and blow you up directly. Also better aim in the direction of the player. And prevent the bug that shooting robots can come to the player position without shooting at him.
- Weakened Rocksy with higher rocket shooting delay.

Have fun with the new updates!

notes.title: Update game pad support and mech rockets
notes.notes:
- Full game pad support. Now with changeable stick sensitivity.
- Fixed bugs on changing keys for keyboard and game pad
- Turret shoot through trees fixed
- Improved flying curve of rockets of Mech
- Nerfed Rocket Robot, was much too strong

notes.title: Small Daily Update
notes.notes:
Hi Testers & Fans!

New update is live on all versions (Demo/Playtest, Full-Beta):
- Complete new Hangar Lightning, Hangar Map is much brighter now. (Please give some feed back if it is good now, or you liked it more dark)
- Better Rocket-launcher for robot

Have fun with the new updates!
